current_episode.title: Can Construction Keep Up? Growth, AI & the Future of the Industry | Jamie Hillier of Akerlof Ep 53

guest.bio_context: Jamie spent nearly 20 years working for a tier one major contractor, starting as a site QS and progressing to pre-construction director for the major projects business, where he covered estimating, digital design, planning, and site-related activities. He co-founded Accaloft with two other partners to bridge the gap between strategic ambitions and on-site delivery, leveraging his contracting experience to embed better practices at the earlier stages of project development.
